- Playwright was available; Playwright's own browser was not installed, so agent-browser Chrome/Chromium 1243 was reused via `executablePath`; CLI commands had a known hanging issue.
- Captcha solving required visual inspection and upscaling; one attempt with an ambiguous operator failed with "验证码错误", and a later `9+1=?` captcha was read as 10 and accepted.

- The usual sequence was commit -> build -> verify hash -> push, but the handoff forbade rerunning the full build; hop3 build had exited 0 and the current session only made a cosmetic indentation fix after that build.
- The main checkout was not detached and was in sync with upstream; four task files were staged with 378 additions and 9 deletions, and HEAD remained `67214a7d0`.

- Nothing was pushed and no Zentao writeback was performed because the commit did not land; the evidence image `zs2908-user-edit-20261125-153450.png` was retained before writeback.
- A hard handoff instruction required stopping after writing `D:/plan/惠山二期G/HANDOFF-CHAIN-zentao2908-account-unfreeze-hop5-20261125-1537.md` with 9 sections; the next `new_once` hop was scheduled as `schedule-10c1d152…` for 2026-11-25 15:38:27 with a four-item prompt and no maxHops.

# Huishan Property Management V1 Frontend (zhi1-web-admin H5)
The Wuxi Huishan property management admin H5 frontend project is validated locally on nginx at localhost:8100.

## Project Information
- GitLab project `gitlab.zhi.com-zhi-wuxi-huishan-wuguan-fe-zhi1-web-admin-h5-g-unlimited`.
- Local deployment uses a self-built nginx site pointing to the local `dist` build, accessible at `http://localhost:8100/`.
- Login uses an admin account plus a graphic arithmetic captcha (2026-11-24 example: `8-5=?`, answer 3).

## Budget Filing Vote Task
- The 2026-11-24 handoff defined the goal and remaining items (sections 1 and 4/9): fix the 404 related to `hasOnlineDecisionPush` after clicking "Start Vote" on the Budget Filing Application detail page.
- Code was changed and the build passed twice as required by section 3 (baseline and post-change, both exit 0; this is a do-not-rerun item).
- Real-browser validation entered the detail page from the todo item "Budget Filing Application - Tianqi City Building A"; after clicking "Start Vote", the network panel showed no `hasOnlineDecisionPush` request and no 404, so the core assertion passed.
- Remaining steps: select maintenance object rows in the dialog, confirm, assert the radio is available and no 404 dialog appears, capture a full-page screenshot, then put evidence in the session, commit/push, write back to Zentao, and clean artifacts.

## Maintenance Fund Vote Route Name Defect
- Root cause: the Huishan site uses route name=`OwnerDecision/owner` for "Maintenance Fund Vote"; `$route.name.split('/')[1]=='owner'` is not 'maintain', so 13 checks each in `estate/ownerDecision/index.vue` and `detail.vue` took the OWNERS branch.
- The same component is reused by routes vote (owners committee election) and supervisory (supervisory committee); commit ae02888b2 had changed owner occurrences in comments to maintain, but the Huishan menu still emitted `OwnerDecision/owner`.
- Fix: checks accept both `owner` and `maintain` through computed `isMaintainDecision` references (index.vue:304 and detail.vue).
- Validation on 2026-11-24: local nginx 8100 site showed 542 records, headers "Associated Business Name" and "Business Type", and request decisionType=MAINTAIN; vote/supervisory regression passed.
- Delivery: remote SHA `9c7dea66e` was pushed and the parent gitlink updated; the uncommitted deletion of `src/api/estate/ownerDecision.js` was left out because it was pre-existing work by someone else.

# Fund Allotment No-Contract Frontend
Huishan Phase 2G zhi2-web-admin Zentao task 2393 implemented no-contract fund allotment applications and multiple withdrawals against one contract.

## Requirements and Changes
- Zentao task 2393: "Frontend [Huishan Property Management] Fund Allotment Supports No-Contract Application and Multiple Contract Withdrawals".
- Branch: `develop/v2.6.2-huishan`; project: Huishan Phase 2G / zhi2-web-admin.
- Reference: Suzhufang G task 2104 commits `dbd161219+7b937cd63` (`pubAllotNotice/detail.vue`, `index.vue`, `pubExpenditureContract/detail.vue`) were ported by three-way `git merge-file`.
- Huishan-specific behavior retained: `cancelPubAllotNotice` uses an inline request call, witness text uses `labelAbove`, and the list "Current Status" column wording uses `fixed=right`.

## Key Capabilities
- Has-contract branch; no-contract cap = pending application amount - `contractReservedAmount`.
- Backend field validation: `haveWithdrawAmount`, `remainWithdrawAmount`, `remainExcludeSelf`.
- Selection dialog filters zero remaining values with `filterZeroRemain` and shows the remaining available application amount in the `remainApplyAmount` column.

## Validation and Deployment
- ESLint reported 0 errors for the three files when run from the zhi2-web-admin cwd with the parent `node_modules\.bin\eslint.cmd`; running from the parent cwd caused 16 alias false positives.
- `npm run build` succeeded; the nginx 8119 site (`惠山二期G.conf`, root=`惠山二期G/dist`) was deployed and MD5-checked.
- Submodule commit `b7b998803` was pushed; parent gitlink `aa09f0d` was pushed.

## Writeback and Status
- Zentao writeback was zt_action 92182 comment (task type, product=",10,", task status unchanged, marked frontend complete pending backend integration).
- Real page end-to-end integration was not executed because it depended on the Huishan backend release.
- On 2026-11-13, a database check confirmed the Huishan Dameng `T_JG_ALLOT_NOTICE` table lacked `HAVE_WITHDRAW_AMOUNT` and `CONTRACT_FLAG` columns, while the Suzhufang test database had them, proving task 2393 server-side work was not implemented; integration was therefore impossible (see Bug 6559).
- On 2026-11-13, Bug 6559 frontend work was fixed and committed: Huishan `6fc3bb94d` (`develop/v2.6.2-huishan`) and Suzhufang `4a32dc38f` (`develop/v2.6.2-suzhufang`), both changing only detail.vue (adding noticeAmount and getDetail fallback); Zentao 6559 was set resolved/fixed (zt_action 92984) and reassigned to fuxiachao; visual page verification was not stable because of a login captcha race, so the note recommended joint verification before closing.
- Source session: 2026-11-12; code baseline: `develop/v2.6.2-huishan`.

# 惠山二期G zhi2-web-admin（惠山物管）
无锡惠山二期G（产品2.0）房地产综合服务平台物管管理端的前端子模块，缺陷在禅道跟踪并回写。

## 仓库与环境
- GitLab 项目 `gitlab.zhi.com-zhi-wuxi-huishan-product-fe-zhi2-web-admin-h5-g-unlimited`；本地路径 `D:\repository\惠山二期G\zhi2-web-admin`；分支 `develop/v2.6.2-huishan`。
- 本地 nginx 站点 `惠山二期G.conf` 原监听 `http://localhost:8119`，2026-11-24 改为 8120（reload 后 HTTP 200，backend 指公司开发网关）并部署 `dist`；登录页有图形算术验证码（2026-11-24 为 `4*5=20`，2026-11-25 为 `9/9=1`），登录后主页显示「惠山区」「待办事项」。
- 端口归属与验证异常：8120 为惠山二期G（`D:/repository/惠山二期G/dist`）；8167 属于苏住房G（suzhufang-g / test），非惠山二期G。2026-11-25 在 8120 验证禅道 2908 用户管理解冻字段时，登录后被重定向到 8101（苏住房），判断为环境/网关配置问题而非单纯选错菜单。
- 生产站点 `http://www.hsqhoafunds.cn:5777/` 可达（HTTP 200）；HTTPS 在 5777 报 SSL 协议错误，只能走 HTTP；登录为 admin + 图形验证码（识别返回 "0" 不可靠，需直接看图）。
- 部署面板端口 18098，机制与 registry 见「部署看板」；2026-11-24 前未登记该项目环境、登录用登记表通用 admin 凭据，当日先登记 prod（port 5777、port_base 5773）与 local（8119），随后迁移为唯一 dev 槽位 8120、账号 `{{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/deploy_env-huishan-g-dev#/values/username}}`，凭据隐私引用 `deploy_env-huishan-g-dev` 注入看板内存（reveal 成功），看板仍显示 `listen_ports:[8119]`、health=down，属旧端口缓存滞后。`gen_nginx_sites.ps1` 会覆盖所有项目故不用于此站点；sync 脚本 null 索引 bug 见「部署看板」。计划与交接文档写在 `D:\plan\惠山二期G`，另有 `.plan/` 目录（如 task2393.md）。

## 路由与代码
- 菜单路由动态生成：静态路由仅 18 条、无 parking，动态路由在 vuex `state.permission.originalRoutes`；点「更多功能」无弹出、侧边栏折叠不出业务菜单。
- 停车泊位列表页 component 为 `benefit/parkingSpace/index`，真实路径 `/ShFund/xqgll/business/parking/parkingSpace`；`router.push` 会被路由守卫弹回 `#/index`，改用 `open` 带真实 hash 路径可直接进入（此前失败路径 `#/benefit/parkingSpace` 有误）。
- 资金拨付列表页路径 `/benefit/pubAllotNotice`，详情页为 `/{id}?formMode=view`；直接导航详情被路由守卫弹回 `#/index`。dev 环境 `getRouters` 报 500，改由 dist 静态路由兜底定位 path；dev 有可作废单据（state=0008/9999，如 `2077233286180032514`），列表接口需带 token，dev 槽位账号可用。
- 物业管理区域信息详情页含「楼幢列表 / 房屋产权」页签；「房屋套数」数字链接（2026-11-25 隆舜园为 12）打开房屋清单弹窗。房屋坐落类展示格式化逻辑集中在新 `src/formatters/housePosition.js`（alias-free，便于 Node 直接单测），经 `src/formatters/index.js` 默认导出 `housePositionFormatter`；详见 zentao_bug_6677。
- grep 需缩窄到子模块目录，仓库根会被拦截。eslint 须在 zhi2-web-admin 目录下用父仓本地 eslint 运行（父目录跑有 16 个 alias 误报）；提交时 lint-staged 仍报 `@/` alias 解析错误，属既存环境问题。惠山文件与苏住房基线差异极小时用 `git merge-file` 三方合并；整文件冲突常为 CRLF/LF 行尾差异，统一行尾后可合并。

## 任务与验证
- 每次改动前确认构建基线；`npm run build` 超过编排器 180s 上限，需改后台进程跑完再轮询日志（2026-11-24 基线 exit 0，改后 verify-build 亦 exit 0）。
- 缺陷修复完成后回写禅道；已处理 bug 6939（停车泊位工具栏隐藏「审批」按钮，见 bug6939_停车泊位审批按钮）、bug 6950（作废接口 GET→POST，见 bug6950_cancel_request_method）、task 2768（维修资金表决 url，见 maintain_vote_url）、bug 6677（房屋坐落缺少分隔符，2026-11-25 修复、验证、推送并回写，见 zentao_bug_6677）、bug 6972（收款账户开户银行必填校验，2026-11-25 修复+验证+提交，见 zentao_bug_6972）。
- bug 6950 于 2026-11-24 收尾完成：禅道 resolved/fixed（action 99120 含内嵌验证图 24229）、子模块 `79093564e` 与父仓 `2d3ca6cc` 已推送、临时产物（`zentao-6950\` 与 `.task-state\`）已清理，交接链 `bug6950-cancel-get-to-post` 终止；前端验证门与代码改动沿用 hop2。
- 禅道 2908（账户解冻迁移，2026-11-25 进行中并交接）：新增 `src/utils/accountFreeze.js`，冻结/解冻 UI 与保存逻辑对齐苏住房 G，涉及 `src/views/system/user/detail.vue`、`src/views/autonomy/userAuth/detail.vue`、`src/views/company/userManagement/operator/operatorAddDialog.vue`；截至交接时 agent-browser 实机验证、npm run build、git 提交、禅道回写尚未做；交接文档 `D:/plan/惠山二期G/HANDOFF-CHAIN-zentao2908-account-unfreeze-hop1-20261125-1412.md`，已排 new_once 续接（chain_id=zentao2908-account-unfreeze）做验证后提交/回写；2026-11-25 续接验证时在 8120 遇登录重定向至 8101（苏住房），实机验证受阻，详见「仓库与环境」。

- 代码已改完、构建已过（第 3 节要求基线+改后各一次 exit=0，属禁止重跑项）

## 维修资金表决路由名缺陷
- 根因：惠山站「维修资金表决」路由 name=`OwnerDecision/owner`，`$route.name.split('/')[1]=='owner'` ≠ 'maintain'，`estate/ownerDecision/` 下 index.vue 与 detail.vue 各 13 处判断走 OWNERS 分支
- 同组件复用路由：vote（业委会选举）、supervisory（监委会）；提交 ae02888b2 曾把注释里的 owner 全量改成 maintain，但惠山菜单仍发 `OwnerDecision/owner`
- 修复：判断同时兼容 `owner` 与 `maintain`，统一用 computed `isMaintainDecision` 引用（index.vue:304 与 detail.vue）
- 验证（2026-11-24）：本地 nginx 8100 站列表 542 条、表头「关联业务名称」「业务类型」、请求 decisionType=MAINTAIN；vote/supervisory 回归通过
- 交付：远端 SHA=9c7dea66e 已推送并更新父仓 gitlink；`src/api/estate/ownerDecision.js` 的未提交删除属他人遗留，未纳入提交
